text:
jen: FYI - small hotfix for auth cache edge-case that causes stale token reuse on long streams. Want to push during the 09:45-10:45 UTC change window as an expedited patch. tagging ops and SRE for approvals.

deploybot: deploybot: Staging E2E failure observed earlier. Candidate image: gcr.redwood/llm-runtime:auth-cache-fix-2026-03-23. Run `/deploy plan --artifact=auth-cache-fix-2026-03-23` to prepare.

mike: Can we do a tighter canary? Suggest 3% for 8m -> 20% for 12m -> 100%. Gate condition: any 5xx spike or error_rate > 1.2% triggers rollback.

nina: +1 on tighter canary. Also request model variant remains on quantized-v3-hotfix to avoid perf regressions.

ops-oncall: I'm oncall. I'll require a smoke run and a perf sanity check before canary. Also need release notes link and approved rollback owner.

sri: I can take rollback ownership if we need to revert. Rollback procedure: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/llm-runtime --to-revision=stable-2026-03-20` and cut traffic to the previous replica set.

jen: Release notes draft: https://redwood-inference.s3/releases/hf-auth-cache-2026-03-23.md — summary + risk section.

releasebot: releasebot: Deploy request queued. To approve reply 'approve' or react with :white_check_mark:. Change window: 09:45-10:45 UTC. Rollout: 3% (8m) -> 20% (12m) -> 100% (monitor). Metric gates: error_rate, p95 latency, cpu.

mike: approve

ops-oncall: :white_check_mark: running smoke now. Will post results.

deploybot: deploybot: Smoke run output: `smoke.sh --target=staging` -> OK. checks: auth flow passes, no 5xx, p95=52ms. Starting canary 3% at 09:52 UTC.

jen: also enabling short-term billing alert for the window (+25% spend threshold) per devex note.

deploybot: deploybot: Canary metrics @09:58 UTC: error_rate=0.05% (ok), p95 latency +2ms, kv_cache_miss stable. Proceeding to 20% at 09:58 UTC.

mike: watch for error_rate trending near 0.8% - if it creeps up, pause and escalate.

ops-oncall: Observability: slow traces looked normal, no increase in 4xx/5xx. Rolling to 100% at 10:12 UTC.

sri: Rollback ready standby cleared.

jen: marking this thread as expedited-approved. Approvals: mike, ops-oncall. I'll file compliance note and append the final release tag `v2.1.9-hotfix-authcache` to the release bucket. Thanks all.
